storeLocationUnavailable: This branch location is unavailable. Please update its store coordinates.
title: Find your nearest Clucky
subtitle: A happy meal, closer to you.
locationWhy: Find nearby branches. You can still search manually without sharing your location.
locationError: Location unavailable. Check location permission or search for an address manually.
locationInsecure: The browser blocks location because this page is not a secure context. On the machine running Clucky, open http://localhost:3000; access by IP/domain from another device requires valid HTTPS. Granting permission does not bypass this restriction. You can still search for an address or place the pin manually.
locationUnsupported: This browser does not provide geolocation. Use a browser that supports it, or search for an address and place the pin manually.
locationDenied: Location access is blocked by the browser or device. Allow location for this site and check the browser's location access in device settings, then retry. You can still select an address manually.
locationUnavailable: The device could not provide current coordinates, even if site permission is allowed. Check device location services and your network connection, then retry. There are no new coordinates; the existing address pin is not a geolocation result.
locationTimeout: The device took too long to determine your location, including the retry. Check location services and your network connection, then use the current-location button again or select a pin manually.
locationPrivacy: Location stays in this session; it is not saved to your profile unless you save an address.
searchHint: Street, neighbourhood or landmark in Vietnam
noResults: No matches yet. Add a street/city or enter your address manually.
searchError: Address search is unavailable. Enter your address manually and choose a map pin.
mapError: Map unavailable. You can still enter an address manually.
pinHint: Click the map or drag the pin to adjust. Check your address before saving.
noPin: No pin — you can save a manually entered address

saveError: Unable to save. Check your details and try again.
loadError: Unable to load your details. Please retry.
selectAddressHint: Choose a saved recipient and address
